goals: Provide the modpack-specific Enderscape adjustment and integration layer for exact Enderscape 3.0.2 on Minecraft Java 26.2 without modifying or repackaging the upstream jar.
Suppress future acquisition and discovery of owner-selected equipment while retaining registry identities needed by existing worlds and inventories.
Reconcile the audited Enderscape food-loot paths with exact current Matcha Flavoured component-bearing identities without changing Enderscape's original loot odds or counts.
Replace the selected native Enderscape foods' vanilla hunger restoration with the owner-selected current Matcha healing semantics while retaining their upstream effects and special behavior.
Remove Rubble Chitin from future normal acquisition and discovery while retaining its registry identity and changing only the Rubblemite reward identity to Nebulite Shards.
Replace the Void Campfire recipe with exact current Matcha Flavoured Kindling plus Void Shale, and move Veiled Sapling acquisition from passive leaf drops to a one-to-one Veiled Leaves recipe.
Expose the effective post-pruning Void Campfire and Veiled Sapling crafting recipes through optional JEI without creating parallel recipe definitions or reviving blocked recipes.
Override only the three selected Enderscape English terrain-block names while preserving registry, world, model, texture, CTM, BGE, recipe, loot, and saved-world identities.
Classify otherwise-unmapped canonical Veiled Leaves from the active vanilla leaf shader classification while preserving explicit shader-pack mappings and leaving BGE geometry propagation generic.
scope: Generate an always-enabled companion layer from the SHA-256-pinned Enderscape input, preserving audited loot-pool math while making only explicit, narrow modpack adjustments and optional client compatibility additions.

Filter only the owner-selected recipes, advancement branches, ordinary Creative/JEI discovery identities, normal enchantment availability, and exact Enderscape-specific direct hunger behavior through Fabric APIs and narrow 3.0.2 mixins.
Package, statically verify, retain, and document Canary 1 without launching Minecraft or changing any testing profile.

Generate C2 overrides for the exact Rubblemite and Veiled Leaves loot tables, the Void Campfire recipe, and the Veiled Sapling recipe; use one narrow custom crafting serializer only because current Matcha Kindling is a component-bearing vanilla item rather than a separate registry entry.

For C3, synchronize that existing custom serializer through Fabric's recipe API so JEI consumes the resolved holder/display, provide only a conflict-free component-subtype fallback when Matcha x JEI Integration is absent, and add one three-key English companion language override ordered after Enderscape.

For C4 and C5, own only the Enderscape-specific canonical Veiled Leaves shader classification, apply it before generic BGE canonical-parent propagation, and keep every common adjustment independent of Iris and shaders.

Build-time source fingerprints and a generation-specific runtime capability replace the C2 provider pin. Food loot and the displayed Kindling stack use current components while existing equipment, Rubblemite, sapling and shader adjustments retain their scope.

exclusions: Enderscape source or binary modification, registry deletion, fork, repackaging, or redistribution; the exact upstream jar remains installed separately and untouched.
Minecraft launches, runtime observations, Test Slot or Test Instance Manager changes, and any access to protected or retired gameplay profiles.
Changes to originals, WORKBENCH_SERVER_STATE.json, Matcha Flavoured, Matcha x JEI Integration, Enderscape's upstream repository, or any unrelated Workbench project.
End biome, terrain, world generation, structures other than the selected future loot evaluation, Magnia behavior/worldgen, Magnia Radio availability, and the potion/Void/brewing/arrow systems.
Claims that build, static checks, or generated artifacts prove Minecraft runtime safety.

exceptions.reason: Targets the 26.2 registry, display and recipe synchronization interfaces.
regression_evidence: The generator and thirty integration tests check the 26.2 serializer, components, loot, discovery and shader boundaries.

exceptions.reason: The generated overlay, retained C2 Void Campfire serializer, three-key language override, string-targeted Chorus Cake Roll mixin, and C5 canonical Veiled Leaves registry lookup are intentionally bound to the audited Enderscape 3.0.2 data and bytecode shape.
regression_evidence: The generator and tests fail closed unless enderscape-fabric-3.0.2+mc26.2.jar matches SHA-256 9fcc4f59ca88e91f90e7c7d18289f2f859f20c810eebcca924764aa15236c40b.

The focused suite verifies the upstream Veiled Leaves model remains a minecraft:block/leaves model with its original texture reference; it adds no Enderscape asset or state rewrite and packages no upstream Enderscape classes or assets beyond the existing companion-owned language override.

exceptions.reason: Only the optional client compatibility callback is tied to Iris's inspected completed BlockMaterialMapping return descriptor; no common Enderscape Integration feature requires Iris or shaders.
regression_evidence: The exact Iris 1.11.2+mc26.2 material mapping implementation was inspected: it completes its state map using putIfAbsent before returning it, so the C5 callback uses containsKey to preserve explicit Veiled Leaves entries and copies the live vanilla oak-leaf value only into absent states.

Exact Sponge Mixin 0.17.3+mixin.0.8.7 (SHA-256 9e90efec71d2bad5b96c9089f019d14a8603227d3c5f408d12f53fae89d99d41) inspection and executable coverage establish that injector order 900 runs before BGE's default 1000 pass; the plugin gates only IrisVeiledLeavesMaterialMappingMixin and has no Iris class linkage.
